item.title: High outage risk: Madison, MO
item.description: 17% chance of a new outage affecting 5% or more of customers, 9 pm to 3 am CST today (range 15%-19%). About 4 to 5 alerts a year per county; in 2025 more than 1 in 4 was followed by an outage. Experimental research forecast, not from your utility or the National Weather Service.

item.title: Elevated outage risk: Madison, MO
item.description: 9% chance of a new outage affecting 5% or more of customers, 5 pm to 11 pm CST today (range 8%-10%). About 9 alerts a year per county; in 2025 about 1 in 5 was followed by an outage. Experimental research forecast, not from your utility or the National Weather Service.
